name: testagent.mandate.eth
description: A Mandate-governed autonomous DeFi trading agent on Ethereum Sepolia. Its authority is not self-declared: the permission scope (allowed protocols, allowed position types, maximum position size, maximum daily spend, and expiry) is published as ENSv2 text records under the `mandate.permissions` key on its subname, and a human-readable summary under `mandate.policy`. Trades are gated at execution time against that published scope together with the agent's ERC-8004 reputation, so an out-of-scope or low-reputation action reverts on-chain rather than being blocked by an off-chain pre-check. Built for ETHOnline 2026.
